# Daily Ukraine–Russia War Analyst Brief — Template

**Audience:** OUSW / Comptroller Program-Budget Analysts
**Recipient:** ericjsanchez23@gmail.com
**Schedule:** 0500 ET daily
**File format:** 2026-06-01_Ukraine-Russia_War_Daily_Analyst_Brief_OUSW-PB

---

## PART I — SENIOR LEADER SNAPSHOT

### A. Bottom Line Up Front (BLUF)
3–5 bullets. What changed in 24–48 hrs? What matters most? U.S. defense/budget impact? Epic Fury overlap?
Each bullet: Source name, URL, Confidence level.

### B. Top Issues for OUSW Comptroller P/B Analysts
5–7 tagged bullets. Tags: [Funding] [Appropriations] [Execution] [PDA] [USAI] [Defense Articles]
[Stockpiles] [Replenishment] [Congressional RFI] [Readiness] [Epic Fury / Iran Linkage]
Each: What happened | Why it matters | Congress/senior leader question.

### C. Watch Items — Next 7 Days
5 items: Indicator | Why it matters | Budget/defense article/congressional implication | Source URL.

### D. Most Likely Congressional RFI Questions Today
5–10 questions based on the day's reporting.

[DIB] [Replenishment] [Readiness] [Congressional Interest] [Epic Fury/Iran Linkage] [Escalation Risk]
[Sanctions] [Energy]

cyber, Black Sea, Crimea, force posture, territorial changes, credible casualties.

### 12. Source Log
**MANDATORY.** Table: # | Source | Title | Date Published | Link | Topic | Confidence | Notes.
Every source must have a working URL. Note: paywalled | official source | analysis | Russian/Ukrainian claim.

### 13. Confidence Matrix
Table: Claim/Topic | Confidence (High/Medium/Low/Cannot confirm) | Reason.
High = official or multiple credible independent sources.
Medium = credible but not independently confirmed.
Low = single source, disputed, or partially verified.
Cannot confirm = insufficient sourcing.

---

## WRITING STANDARDS

- Department-level analyst style: direct language, short paragraphs, clear bullets, tables
- Source links under every finding
- No political commentary, no unsupported claims, no sensational wording
- No "many reports say" without listed sources
- Russian/Ukrainian official claims labeled as claims unless confirmed
- All confidence levels labeled

## QUALITY CHECK BEFORE SEND

- [ ] Every major claim has a source and working URL
- [ ] Unverified claims clearly labeled
- [ ] Russian/Ukrainian official claims labeled
- [ ] Senior Leader Snapshot present
- [ ] Analyst Annex complete
- [ ] Defense articles/stockpile section complete
- [ ] Epic Fury / Ukraine linkage section complete
- [ ] Congressional RFI section complete
- [ ] Source log complete
- [ ] Budget/appropriations/execution/stockpile/readiness implications identified
